item.title: Munis a tad firmer out long, 'positive view' of market
item.description: There is a positive view of the muni market in the long-term due to a mix of attractive tax-adjusted yields and a generally favorable credit backdrop, said Cooper Howard, director of fixed income research and strategy at Charles Schwab.

item.title: KBRA and Fitch downgrade Chicago
item.description: KBRA and Fitch Ratings downgraded Chicago's general obligation bonds to BBB-plus from A-minus on Wednesday, and both kept their rating outlooks at negative.

item.title: Fitch's draft climate screening tool gets a cautious nod from MMA
item.description: Fitch Ratings released a draft of climate vulnerability in rating criteria for public finance issuers that earned a thumbs-up from Municipal Market Analytics.

item.title: Florida may face another three-way fight over budget
item.description: The Republican governor and GOP leaders of the state House and Senate will negotiate over three budget visions and a plan to cut local property tax revenue.

item.title: Tariffs, political turmoil pose major threats to public finance
item.description: Findings from The Bond Buyer's 2026 Predictions Report show tax shakeups and political uncertainty pose major challenges to public finance.

item.title: Focus sharpens on surface transportation reauthorization
item.description: Congressional leadership is dropping hints about the size, scope, and delivery dates of the surface transportation reauthorization bill that will supplant the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law.

item.title: Muni industry's adoption of AI prompts regulatory, other questions
item.description: If building out AI tools requires a big investment, "it sure helps to have the capital," said Justin Marlowe, a research professor in the University of Chicago Harris School of Public Policy.

item.title: Puerto Rico port concessionaire bond outlook lowered by S&P
item.description: S&P revised its outlook to negative on San Juan Cruise Port LLC's BBB-minus rated bonds.

item.title: Austin OKs $1.4 billion of bonds for airport expansion
item.description: The airport system revenue bonds will finance portions of an estimated $5 billion expansion program at Austin Bergstrom International Airport.

item.title: Muni yields tick down, sizable inflows continue
item.description: Investors added $1.029 billion to municipal bond mutual funds in the week ended Wednesday, following $1.269 billion of inflows the prior week, according to LSEG Lipper data. This is the seventh time in eight weeks that inflows have topped $1 billion.
